# Applicability matrix

Applicability answers one question only: has the trigger occurred? It never answers whether SSLS
satisfies the obligation. NOT-APPLICABLE is not a pass.

## APPLIES-NOW (7)

The trigger has occurred. The obligation is live for the current build.

| ID | Title | Trigger | Control status |
|---|---|---|---|
| OBL-014 | Internal conformance target version | SSLS publishes a user interface. | PARTIAL |
| OBL-019 | Dependency vulnerability identification and remediation | SSLS maintains a software product with third-party dependencies. | IMPLEMENTED |
| OBL-020 | Dependency licence posture | SSLS distributes or hosts software containing third-party components. | PARTIAL |
| OBL-025 | Existing law applies to AI claims and behaviour | SSLS makes any public statement about AI capability, including a statement about future capability. | IMPLEMENTED |
| OBL-032 | Accuracy of public claims on the published prototype | A public surface exists at a reachable URL. | IMPLEMENTED |
| OBL-033 | Zero personal data on the current surface | The scope test is continuous: the obligation attaches the moment personal information is received. | IMPLEMENTED |
| OBL-034 | Branch protection and change-control enforcement | SSLS maintains a repository that is the authorised software source of truth. | PARTIAL |
